flags: PRICE GATE - drop candidate for AWH: cheapest motorhome site $49 on May and September 2027 weeknights (at the gate), but $66 on a June 2027 weeknight (Tue 2027-06-15) - over US$50 for the whole summer season. gateways.py: none within 40 km (nearest Cuyahoga Valley NP 105 km). Not a Good Sam Park (directory gs false). Google Maps: Shelby/Mansfield KOA, 4.5 from 470 reviews, (419) 347-1392, koa.com. Reviews are good, but $66 is not a borderline price, so they don't decide it; the shoulder $49 is what keeps it in if AWH counts the cheapest season.
The 30-amp water/electric back-in type (possibly cheaper) is not offered to a motorhome ('Your equipment type is not compatible with these sites').
